summary.text: Tim Bonner is a Republican state representative from Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 17 who assumed office on December 1, 2022 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is an attorney by profession.

paragraphs.text: Tim Bonner graduated from Penn Hills High School, earned a B.A. in political science from Westminster College, and received a J.D. from the University of Notre Dame Law School.
His career experience includes working as an attorney.
In the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the Committee on Ethics and to the Health and Judiciary committees, chairing the subcommittees on health facilities and on family law.
